goal: Remove AI and AD access-mutation paths before changing role authority semantics.
runtime_operation_scope: Migrate data/contracts/ai/tools.json through the reviewed runtime-contract path; never commit the runtime copy.
acceptance: No AI dispatcher or tool contract can create, edit, assign, or remove roles, technical groups, privileged flags, account activation, department, username, or AD identity.
access.users.update has no remaining write behavior and is removed from dispatch and tool contracts.
AI can explain access and open or prefill the human editor.
AD identity/profile sync continues while role mutation remains fail-closed.
PendingAction remains unchanged for non-access AI actions.
